newsitem.title: USA: Genta sets one-for-10 reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Genta sets one-for-10 reverse stock split.

text.p: Genta Inc Tuesday said its stockholders approved an amendment to its restated certificate of incorporation effecting a one-for-10 reverse stock split of its common stock.

At the company's annual meeting on Friday, April 4, the stockholders also approved a reduction in the biopharmaceutical company's authorized shares of common stock from 150 million to 70 million. The company commenced trading on a post-reverse split basis at the start of trading on Monday, April 7.
As a result of the reverse stock split, the company's NASDAQ symbol has been temporarily changed from GNTAC to GNTCD. The symbol will revert back to GNTAC on May 5, 1997.
